name: Articore Group Limited
summary: Articore Group Limited, established in 2006 and headquartered in Docklands, Australia, runs online marketplaces where creators upload designs and consumers buy products carrying custom artwork, in Australia, the United States, the United Kingdom and other markets. Its businesses are Redbubble and TeePublic, selling clothing, stationery, home decor, bags and wall art, and it also handles payment processing.
